answer_2.quote: The description s_f is considered faithful if the mean activation for the activating examples exceeds that of the neutral examples, namely: mactivating > mneutral

answer_3.quote: We feed s_f concatenated with T_f , T_f' and T_f'' to a judge LLM ... and task it to indicate which of the three sets matches s_f
methods: LLM selection task where the judge chooses which generated text set matches the feature description

answer_4.quote: We conducted two human evaluations. Human annotators were given feature descriptions ... Each annotator then indicated which of the three sets matches the given description. We also tasked human annotators (6 graduate students) with scoring their faithfulness with respect to (a) input‑faithfulness ... and (b) output‑faithfulness ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to judge whether generated text sets matched the feature description and to score input‑faithfulness and output‑faithfulness of the descriptions.
